import MumfordLib.SingularSmallCochainPrimitive
import MumfordLib.SimplicialCochainGluing

/-!
# Cocycle comparison for small singular chains

Restriction to the small chains of an open cover lifts cocycles in every
degree and detects coboundaries in positive degrees. Both statements use
the subdivision primitive in the kernel of restriction.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

noncomputable section

open CategoryTheory Limits

namespace Mumford.Analytic

variable {X : TopCat} {ι : Type*} {n : ℕ}

/-- An open cover's small chains already detect every degree-zero cochain. -/
theorem singularZeroCochain_eq_zero_of_zero_on_small
    (U : ι → Set X) (hopen : ∀ i, IsOpen (U i))
    (hcover : ∀ x : X, ∃ i, x ∈ U i)
    (φ : IntegralSingularCochain X 0)
    (hφ : (smallSingularChainInclusion X U).f 0 ≫ φ = 0) : φ = 0 := by
  apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro c
  obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ := singularCochain_eventually_subdivision_eq_zero U hopen hcover φ hφ c
  have hS : End.of (singularSubdivision X 0) = 1 := singularSubdivision_zero X
  have he := hK K le_rfl
  rw [hS, one_pow] at he
  exact he

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
/-- Every small singular cocycle lifts to a singular cocycle. -/
theorem smallSingularCocycle_exists_lift
    (U : ι → Set X) (hopen : ∀ i, IsOpen (U i))
    (hcover : ∀ x : X, ∃ i, x ∈ U i)
    (α : IntegralSimplicialCochain (smallSingularSubcomplex X U) n)
    (hα : simplicialCochainDifferential _ n α = 0) :
    ∃ φ : IntegralSingularCochain X n,
      singularCochainCoboundary φ = 0 ∧
        simplicialCochainPullback (smallSingularSubcomplex X U).ι n φ = α := by
  let A := smallSingularSubcomplex X U
  obtain ⟨φ, hφ⟩ := simplicialCochainPullback_subcomplex_surjective A n α
  change IntegralSingularCochain X n at φ
  have hz : (smallSingularChainInclusion X U).f (n + 1) ≫
      singularCochainCoboundary φ = 0 := by
    change simplicialCochainPullback A.ι (n + 1)
      (simplicialCochainDifferential (TopCat.toSSet.obj X) n φ) = 0
    rw [simplicialCochainPullback_differential, hφ, hα]
  let ψ := singularSmallCochainPrimitive U hopen hcover
    (singularCochainCoboundary φ) hz
  have hd : singularCochainCoboundary ψ = singularCochainCoboundary φ :=
    singularSmallCochainPrimitive_coboundary U hopen hcover _
      (singularCochainCoboundary_squared φ) hz
  have hψ : simplicialCochainPullback A.ι n ψ = 0 :=
    singularSmallCochainPrimitive_zero_on_small U hopen hcover _ hz
  refine ⟨φ - ψ, ?_, ?_⟩
  · change (IntegralSingularChainComplex X).d (n + 1) n ≫ (φ - ψ) = 0
    rw [Preadditive.comp_sub]
    exact sub_eq_zero.mpr hd.symm
  · rw [map_sub, hφ, hψ, sub_zero]

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
/-- A positive-degree cocycle is a coboundary if and only if its restriction
to small chains is a coboundary. -/
theorem singularCocycle_exists_primitive_iff_small
    (U : ι → Set X) (hopen : ∀ i, IsOpen (U i))
    (hcover : ∀ x : X, ∃ i, x ∈ U i)
    (φ : IntegralSingularCochain X (n + 1))
    (hφ : singularCochainCoboundary φ = 0) :
    (∃ ψ, singularCochainCoboundary ψ = φ) ↔
      ∃ α : IntegralSimplicialCochain (smallSingularSubcomplex X U) n,
        simplicialCochainDifferential _ n α =
          simplicialCochainPullback (smallSingularSubcomplex X U).ι (n + 1) φ := by
  let A := smallSingularSubcomplex X U
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨ψ, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨simplicialCochainPullback A.ι n ψ,
      (simplicialCochainPullback_differential A.ι ψ).symm⟩
  · rintro ⟨α, hα⟩
    obtain ⟨ψ, hψ⟩ := simplicialCochainPullback_subcomplex_surjective A n α
    change IntegralSingularCochain X n at ψ
    have hzero : singularCochainCoboundary (φ - singularCochainCoboundary ψ) = 0 := by
      change (IntegralSingularChainComplex X).d (n + 2) (n + 1) ≫
        (φ - singularCochainCoboundary ψ) = 0
      rw [Preadditive.comp_sub]
      change singularCochainCoboundary φ -
        singularCochainCoboundary (singularCochainCoboundary ψ) = 0
      rw [hφ, singularCochainCoboundary_squared, sub_self]
    have hsmall : (smallSingularChainInclusion X U).f (n + 1) ≫
        (φ - singularCochainCoboundary ψ) = 0 := by
      rw [Preadditive.comp_sub]
      change simplicialCochainPullback A.ι (n + 1) φ -
        simplicialCochainPullback A.ι (n + 1)
          (simplicialCochainDifferential (TopCat.toSSet.obj X) n ψ) = 0
      rw [simplicialCochainPullback_differential, hψ, hα, sub_self]
    obtain ⟨θ, hθ⟩ := singularCocycle_exists_primitive_of_zero_on_small
      U hopen hcover _ hzero hsmall
    refine ⟨θ + ψ, ?_⟩
    change (IntegralSingularChainComplex X).d (n + 1) n ≫ (θ + ψ) = φ
    rw [Preadditive.comp_add]
    change singularCochainCoboundary θ + singularCochainCoboundary ψ = φ
    rw [hθ, sub_add_cancel]

end Mumford.Analytic
